folds.text: A **skill** is a folder of instructions, and sometimes scripts and resources, that Claude loads when a task calls for it. Think of it as a recipe card Claude can pull out.
Claude checks which skills fit your request and loads only those. That keeps its desk, the context window, from filling up with instructions it does not need.
Some skills come from Anthropic, like making Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files. Others are **custom skills** you or your organisation write for your own routines.
A simple skill is just written instructions in Markdown, so you do not need to code. Skills also work in Claude Code. To browse them in the app, open Customize, then Skills.
Skills can include scripts, so treat them like any app: review a skill before you rely on it, especially one that someone else wrote.
